gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
We owe our success to her ___ (VISION) leadership.
The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
The vaccine gives ___ (PROTECT) against three strains.
gaps.explanation: 'Gives protection against' — the noun is required.

gaps.sentence: This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.

gaps.sentence: They're ___ (HOPE) that the talks will resume.
gaps.explanation: 'Be hopeful that…' = feeling hope; 'hopefully' is the adverb.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.
